intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information when you use our quiz application. We value your privacy and collect only the data necessary to operate and improve the service.

collected.title: Information We Collect
collected.item1: Country of origin, to generate anonymous usage statistics
collected.note: We do not collect names, emails, or any personally identifying data.

usage.title: How We Use This Information
usage.content: We use this information solely to:
usage.item1: Understand where our users come from (country-level statistics)
usage.item2: Improve and optimize the quiz experience

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We use standard security measures to protect data and ensure that no personal information is exposed or misused.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: We may use third-party tools (e.g., analytics providers) that receive anonymized technical information, such as browser type or device, to help us understand how users interact with the site.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You can contact us if you wish to request information about data handling or deletion. Since we do not store identifiable personal data, there is usually nothing to delete.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy occasionally. Updates will be published on this page.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: If you have any questions, please reach out through our website.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.alertDesc: The PC build recommendations provided by this service are generated by AI and may not always reflect the most current market prices, availability, or compatibility. Please verify all recommendations before making any purchase.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using this quiz application, you accept and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

aiContent.title: AI-Generated Content
aiContent.content: Our service uses artificial intelligence to generate PC build recommendations. These recommendations:
aiContent.item1: Are based on the information you provide in the quiz
aiContent.item2: May not reflect current market prices or availability
aiContent.item3: Should be verified before making any purchase decisions
aiContent.item4: Are suggestions only and not guarantees of performance or compatibility

useOfService.title: Use of Service
useOfService.content: You agree to use this service for lawful purposes only. You must not misuse our service by introducing malicious code or attempting to gain unauthorized access.

limitation.title: Limitation of Liability

accuracy.title: Accuracy of Information
accuracy.content: While we strive to provide accurate and up-to-date information, we make no warranties about the completeness, reliability, or accuracy of the recommendations provided.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting.
